issues.explanation: Maya said she was four when Grace found her alone at the carnival, but Richard says she was two when he lost her at the carnival. Both could be true only if two years passed between, which is unexplained.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Richard's line to 'You were only four years old when I lost you at that carnival.'

issues.explanation: Maya was established as living in a one-room apartment on Maple Street, but in Ep8 her apartment building is on Oak Avenue, with no move shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Change 'Oak Avenue' to 'Maple Street' in the Ep8 dialogue and slugline.

issues.explanation: Maya has worn the locket regularly (Ep1, Ep4) and recently discussed it at the gala. Claiming she hasn't opened it in years is not strictly incompatible, but 'first time in years' is plausible. Not a conflict.
The locket is engraved 'M.H.', which matches Mia Hale, so this is consistent.
